projects.description: Co-led programming for high school FTC Robotics Team

coverImage.alt: Image of VPCI FIRST Tech Challenge Robots

modalData.description: In high school, I was my team's Programming Co-Lead for our FTC Robotics team. We had our rookie year in Gr. 11, and it was a fun experience learning to program both tele-op and autonomous modes when we didn't have much relevant prior experience. I was most proud that we got a 50-point auton working.
features: Uses model trained on pre-built FTC tooling to detect location of game-piece
Coordinates of detected game-piece used to decide where to place pixels
Path-planning and PIDS using the RoadRunner Odometry to path towards locations for placing pixels
